about: Adame Garza, LLP is a personal injury firm with a single office in Houston.
The firm states that the first consultation is free. It publishes material in English and Spanish. It does not state a fee model on its public pages, so none is recorded here.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.

G1.evidence: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Texas does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile; Secretary of State registration still to confirm

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.

G6.evidence: 1,291 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2019-08-20, so it has been operating for more than a year

score.verdict: 2 eligibility gate(s) still to be checked. 2 could not be answered from the available records (G1, G2) and do not count against the firm.
